items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a classical Weil cohomology theory the degree map of a product of smooth projective varieties is the tensor product of the degree maps of the factors (statement lines 1718-1722). The proof (proof lines 1723-1737) identifies the one dimensional top cohomology of the product and compares the two maps on the class of a product of closed points. H2: a complete short computation.
